Title: Users may be unable to access or perform several actions in Microsoft 365 services
Message:
User impact: Users may be unable to access or perform several actions in Microsoft 365 services.

Current status: We're observing signs of sustained recovery throughout the affected environment, and while our investigation into the underlying root cause is ongoing, we're continuing to monitor the impacted services to verify service health levels remain stable. This issue impacts Outlook.com, OneDrive, OneNote, Microsoft To Do, Teams, and Microsoft 365 for the web although you may also see issues in other Microsoft 365 services.

Next update by: Friday, November 13, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC
